segments.text: Hi Sarah, this is Mark from the bank. I'm calling to discuss your recent loan application.
Oh, hi Mark. Thanks for calling. Do you have an update for me?
Yes, I do. I'm happy to inform you that your application has been approved.
That's fantastic news! Thank you so much.
You're very welcome. I'll send over the final documents for you to sign via email shortly.
Perfect, I'll look out for that. Thanks again.
You're welcome. Have a great day.
